newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes limit down on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes limit down on long liquidation.

text.p: Speculative long liquidation linked to signals the market was overbought knocked CBOT rice futures down the 30 cent per cwt trading limit by the close in the nearby three contracts, traders said.
"The market broke on long liquidation from various houses," a trader said.
Traders said there were roughly 50 lots offered at the limit down levels and rice Wednesday will trade with expanded 45 cent per cwt trading limits.
"The market is awaiting tender results from Iraq and Colombia," a trader said.
Colombia is slated to tender for 50,000 tonnes of rice and Iraq tendered Monday for 30,000 tonnes of U.S. rice.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 1,000 contracts, above the 491 traded Monday.
Rice closed seven to 30 cents per cwt lower, with March down 30 at $11.88-1/2.
